stages.english: Good morning everyone. Thank you for joining the class today.
stages.chinese: 大家早上好，感谢今天来上课。

stages.english: We will take a short break now. Please come back when the break ends.
stages.chinese: 现在短暂休息，请在休息结束时回来。

stages.english: For a fixed resistor in this ideal circuit, Ohm's law is voltage equals current multiplied by resistance: V equals I R.
stages.chinese: 在这个理想电路中，对固定电阻，欧姆定律是电压等于电流乘以电阻，即 V = IR。

stages.english: A current of 0.2 amperes through a 10 ohm resistor gives a voltage of 2 volts.
stages.chinese: 0.2 安培电流通过 10 欧姆电阻时，电压为 2 伏特。
